results.notes: Substrate all correct and verified in corpus + quran-verses.json: Surah 9 uniquely lacks the basmala (hard mushaf fact); 9:1 opens with بَرَآءَة (root برأ, 'disavowal') as its literal first word; 8:75 ends al-Anfal on ٱلْأَرْحَام (kinship/alliance, root رحم) placed فِى كِتَٰبِ ٱللَّهِ; adjacency 8->9 confirmed. The reading is NOT imposed and is CLASSICALLY RECOVERED: cross_reference_tafsir on 9:1 returns al-Jalalayn stating explicitly that the basmala is an amaan (security) and that this surah 'was revealed to lift security by the sword' (البَسْمَلَة أمان وهِيَ نَزَلَتْ لِرَفْعِ الأَمْن بِالسَّيْفِ), plus Hudhayfa's 'surah of the sword/punishment' report. This is precisely the reveal's payoff (absent mercy-formula = withdrawn security), so the juxtaposition the candidate offers is seen by the tradition, not projected. The candidate honestly brackets the athar-based 'why' as tradition rather than proof. No overlap: at-Tawbah folder's earliest file is ayah-005, no ayah-001 or basmala-seam file exists. Whole-surah-boundary phenomenon that per-passage files structurally miss. Strong.

Substrate all correct: 54:55 literally ends al-Qamar on مُقْتَدِر (root قدر, power-name), preceded by مَلِيك (root ملك); 55:1 literally opens al-Rahman on ٱلرَّحْمَٰن (root رحم); destruction-refrain فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ verified at 54:16/18/21/30; adjacency 54->55 confirmed. TWO problems keep this from CONFIRMED. (1) IMPOSED-CHECK: cross_reference_tafsir on 54:55 and 55:1 shows the four CORE mufassirun (Ibn Kathir, Tabari, Muyassar, Jalalayn) do NOT note any muqtadir->rahman boundary hinge; they gloss each verse internally. The seam rests solely on al-Biqa'i's Nazm al-Durar munasaba (not in the four sources checked), so it is a munasaba-grounded REFLECTION, not recovered core-tafsir, and must be flagged as such rather than presented as an observed nazm. Additionally, 54:55 is the surah's reward-close, not its judgment terminus: 54:54-55 place the muttaqin in gardens 'in a seat of truth with a Sovereign Omnipotent', and al-Jalalayn reads عند مليك مقتدر as nearness/honor from God's favor (إشارة إلى الرتبة والقربة من فضله) — so muqtadir at the seam is power-in-a-mercy-context, and 'designed whiplash of two faces' overstates what is really a modulation (power already turning toward intimacy, then mercy named outright). (2) OVERLAP is stronger than the candidate disclosed: candidate flagged only ayahs-001-004, but content/tadabbur/055-ar-rahman/ayah-021.md line 157 ALREADY publishes the al-Qamar<->ar-Rahman adjacency explicitly ('The surah just before this one, al-Qamar... Then Ar-Rahman answers it... Two adjacent surahs, two refrains'). That existing treatment uses the REFRAIN contrast (destruction-refrain vs favor-refrain), not the last-word/first-word attribute hinge, so NAZM-6's narrower muqtadir->rahman word-seam is still distinct but sits inside already-covered territory.
results.corrected: Narrow the reveal strictly to the exact boundary-WORD attribute hinge: al-Qamar's final word مُقْتَدِر (Omnipotent, Power) meeting al-Rahman's opening word ٱلرَّحْمَٰن (Mercy) wall-to-wall in the mushaf. Frame it explicitly as a surah-order munasaba REFLECTION (al-Biqa'i lineage), flagged 'not noted by the core mufassirun at this seam' — downgrade any 'designed whiplash' language from asserted intent to suggestive reflection. And cross-reference / build atop the existing ar-Rahman ayah-021 treatment of the same adjacency rather than presenting the al-Qamar->ar-Rahman pairing as new; the only genuinely fresh contribution is the last-word/first-word attribute pair, so lead with that and cite the prior refrain-contrast coverage.
